population: 11 exact constructed development cases; one preselected local pilot, reuse at 1/4/16 goals, guard/source/claim mutations, an unresolved observation, unsupported source and forcing-budget controls; no external holdout
registration: Commit exact source/request/limits/outcome hashes before comparative execution. Keep failures and disclose all corrections. The local registration commit predates runs; server publication can be later.
profile: One nonsign ascending-loop cell, physical phases A=(false,0), B=(true,0), C=(true,1); source admitted by retained lower_source.compile_source. A fixed label (m,a,g,y) is bound per request. No whole-word theorem, phase quotient or signed-profile transfer.
native: Eight concrete subsets, union and intersection, 128 explicit binary table entries. Each seed has three physical branch obligations; the three phase evaluations are cached and fully charged. This exposes the complete selected local transition, not the global source quotient or an eight-cell action table.
bridge: Guarded inverse image under the actual deterministic, phase-closed source cell preserves union and intersection by a checked pointwise Boolean identity. The concrete powerset carrier must remain protected: only identity descent is admitted. Never repair contradictory source facts with a quotient.
routes: forcing: same four source seeds, native tables, retained pure_rows producer and independent checker
no_saturation: same seeds and tables, generated subalgebra only; an ungenerated target remains unresolved
direct_seeds: same four source seeds, ordinary Boolean decomposition/range lemma and cache, no congruence saturation or unnecessary native tables
direct_cell: cold direct target evaluation from the same three branch facts and cache, without buying seeds or tables
control_lemma: For K=h(ABC), b=h(B), bc=h(BC), the disjoint atomic images are K\bc, b, bc\b. Union the requested atoms. This follows from concrete guarded inverse image, not from preservation of absolute complement.
trace: Instrument actual calls including checker calls. Forcing and no_saturation forbid target action queries, full source_quotient/replay_rows and legacy source builders. Fresh replay forbids producer/search imports. Ledger is diagnostic, not cryptographic evidence.
measurements: complete source admission including repeated checker parses
all three source-cell evaluations and independent branch replay
all seed attempts and cached reuse
native table construction and every checked entry
pure-row search scans/events/rounds and independent checks
direct range/direct cell work and ordinary cache
instrumented preparation, route and replay time
reuse: One preparation per registered batch, with 1/4/16 requested goal occurrences, four distinct goals at most. Repeated goals are ordinary cache hits for every route. Seeds have no independent workload demand in this experiment and are fully charged. Report marginal lookup separately from cold end-to-end work.
acceptance: Mechanism: source-bound S=4,D=8, target 3 outside S, independently replayable consumer proof, no direct target query and a genuine no-saturation obligation. Utility: retain the result even if direct controls win; no speedup claim from tiny development timings. A1 restricts forcing to cases whose checked preparation can be justified; PR43 query/planner/reuse need not depend on an I speedup.
preservation: Accepted PR41 and all older files remain byte-identical except the existing current workflow and additive test registry
